botMessages.message: Hi, I'm Data 360 Marketing Agent! . How can I help?

conversationVariables.description: Data space developer name for ALM/metadata lookups. Defaults to 'default'; set from GetSegmentByNameOrId for an open segment. Bound explicitly so it is never slot-filled with a DMO name.
conversationVariables.label: Dataspace

conversationVariables.description: How MergeSegmentCriteria combines new filters with the current segment's criteria: append, replace, or smart.
conversationVariables.label: Merge Mode

conversationVariables.description: One-shot loop-back signal from SearchAlmAttributes on an attribute override: the rewritten request (attributes named explicitly) that ExtractConditions re-extracts from. Set on the override turn and cleared as soon as ExtractConditions consumes it.
conversationVariables.label: Rewritten Utterance

conversationVariables.description: Whether user is on segment edit canvas
conversationVariables.label: Is Edit Canvas

conversationVariables.description: Segment type: always Ui (an ordinary UI-built segment). No other type is supported.
conversationVariables.label: Segment Type

conversationVariables.description: Id of the segment currently open on the edit canvas. Seeded by the segment builder page (setSegmentContext) as 'segmentId' when is_edit_canvas is true.
conversationVariables.label: Segment Id

conversationVariables.description: Controls MapConditions Pass-2 batching. 'auto' (default) runs a single Pass-2 call for small catalogs and switches to parallel DMO-chunked calls (joined by a deterministic weighted reduce) only for large catalogs that risk gateway timeouts; 'true' always
conversationVariables.label: Pass 2 Batching

conversationVariables.description: The next topic to be visited
conversationVariables.label: Next Topic

conversationVariables.description: Publish cadence: standard or rapid. Rapid refreshes hourly (1h/4h).
conversationVariables.label: Publish Type

conversationVariables.description: The filters being built on the current pass, captured verbatim from ExtractConditions (which is given the audience for a new segment, or only the filters being added/changed when the segment already exists - never the filters that segment already holds) a
conversationVariables.label: User Utterance

conversationVariables.description: SelectMappingDmos result: the calculated insights relevant to the conditions, each with its subject, join path, measures (type + whether the measure rolls up) and filterable dimensions. ALM is loaded only in SelectMappingDmos, so this payload is the only
conversationVariables.label: Selected Cis Json

conversationVariables.description: DMO API name for segment-on entity (e.g., ssot__Individual__dlm)
conversationVariables.label: Segment On Entity

conversationVariables.description: Id of the segment this flow is saving to when no canvas is open: the segment the user named as the target of an add/update (resolved by load_target_segment) or the one CreateOrUpdateSegment has just created. Empty means the flow will create a new segment.
conversationVariables.label: Headless Segment Id

conversationVariables.description: load_target_segment output: the display name of the existing segment the request adds filters to, so the update can be confirmed to the user by name.
conversationVariables.label: Target Segment Name

conversationVariables.description: GetSegmentByNameOrId output: the current segment's existing exclude criteria filter DSL JSON (empty if none).
conversationVariables.label: Current Exclude Criteria Json

conversationVariables.description: System page context, refreshed every turn: the Salesforce app the user is looking at now. The segment builder canvas lives in 'standard__Audience360'. Never set by reasoning.
conversationVariables.label: Current App Name

conversationVariables.description: The open canvas's live criteria as {include, exclude}, refreshed by the segment builder page on every change. Threaded into MergeSegmentCriteria so a filter the marketer added without saving is merged into rather than replaced. Never read or written by re
conversationVariables.label: Canvas Criteria Json

conversationVariables.description: SelectMappingDmos result: the JSON array of DMO api names relevant to the conditions, threaded into SearchAlmAttributes.
conversationVariables.label: Mapping Dmos Json

conversationVariables.description: ExtractConditions result: the conditions plus the binary logicalShape, threaded into MapConditions and GenerateSegmentDsl.
conversationVariables.label: Conditions Json

conversationVariables.description: GetSegmentByNameOrId output: the current segment's segment-on DMO api name.
conversationVariables.label: Current Segment On

conversationVariables.description: Runtime condition evaluation for if statements
conversationVariables.label: Runtime Condition 1

conversationVariables.description: Publish schedule interval: NO_REFRESH (manual), 12h or 24h for standard, 1h or 4h for rapid.
conversationVariables.label: Publish Schedule

conversationVariables.description: State-machine cursor for the build steps AFTER type/publish selection: extract_conditions -> select_entity -> map_conditions -> resolve_paths -> add_to_canvas -> post_dsl -> done, with post_dsl going through save_update for a headless update (merge first,
conversationVariables.label: Next Step

conversationVariables.description: System page context, refreshed every turn: the kind of page the user is looking at now. The segment builder canvas is a 'standard__component' page, so any other value means the canvas the conversation started on is no longer open. Never set by reasoning.
conversationVariables.label: Current Page Type

conversationVariables.description: ResolvePaths result: the join path / container per DMO.
conversationVariables.label: Path Mappings Json

conversationVariables.description: GetSegmentByNameOrId output: the current segment's existing include criteria filter DSL JSON (empty if none).
conversationVariables.label: Current Include Criteria Json

conversationVariables.description: MapConditions result: each condition mapped to a DMO + attribute + operator + value.
conversationVariables.label: Condition Mappings Json

conversationVariables.description: SelectMappingDmos result: the existing segments the request's conditions read from (id, name, type, publish cadence, status, publish state and the nesting mode that follows from it). A segment is resolved as a source there, alongside the DMOs and calculat
conversationVariables.label: Nested Segments Json

conversationVariables.description: The agent instructions
conversationVariables.label: Agent Instructions

conversationVariables.description: GenerateSegmentDsl output: the finalized segment filter DSL added to the canvas (renders the Add filter button).
conversationVariables.label: Generated Filters

conversationVariables.description: GenerateSegmentDsl output: the finalized negated (exclude) filter DSL, passed as excludeFilters to headless create/update. Empty when the request has no exclusions.
conversationVariables.label: Generated Exclude Filters

conversationVariables.description: The candidate groupings ExtractConditions returned on the prior turn; passed back so a user selection can be resolved deterministically.
conversationVariables.label: Extract Candidates Json

conversationVariables.description: SearchAlmAttributes result: the resolved per-DMO attributes map (category + relevantAttributes), threaded into MapConditions as its attribute catalog. Also passed back as priorResultJson to resolve the user's disambiguation picks.
conversationVariables.label: Relevant Attributes Json
